scope.intended_use: Let an adult sweep euro circulating coins out of a pocket across a shaped slope into open, labelled, denomination-separated recesses on a dry indoor desk or entryway surface.
scope.user_context: Adult daily pocket emptying. metriCreate digital-first: the customer selects denominations, coins per recess and footprint, and downloads the generated model.
variants: Euro circulating coins 1c to 2 EUR at the EU-fixed nominal diameters
customer-selected denomination subset, recess capacity and tray footprint
out_of_scope: Worn, foreign, commemorative, damaged and pre-issue coins
Secure storage, authentication, counting or any financial-protection function
Child use — loose coins are a choking hazard
Wet, outdoor, load-bearing or vehicle use
Any separation claim before the recess clearance is qualified by coupon

entities.name: Parametric coin tray with swept slope and labelled recesses
Euro circulating coins at the EU-fixed nominal diameters
Dry flat indoor desk or entryway surface
Adult user sweeping and picking coins by hand
Pinned Anycubic Kobra 3 Max / SUNLU PETG Black FFF baseline

interfaces.name: Euro circulating coin to labelled denomination recess

allowed: drop a coin in from above
lift a coin out through the finger notch
constrained: a coin entering a recess of a smaller denomination

assembly.direction: swept in from the slope by hand
assembly.sequence_notes: Every recess is open-topped and reachable by one adult finger.

dimensions.feature: recess diameter = coin nominal plus process clearance
smallest diameter step in the set, 10c 19.75 to 2c 18.75 = 1.00 mm

environment_and_variation.environment: dry adult indoor desk or entryway

keepouts_and_access: No secure storage, authentication, counting-machine, child-use or financial-protection claim.
Worn, foreign, commemorative and damaged coins are out of scope.

evidence.uncertainty_note: Calibration registry returns NO_MATCHING_PROCESS for Anycubic Kobra 3 Max / SUNLU PETG / 0.4 mm; hole_delta_vertical and xy_clearance_sliding are UNQUALIFIED. Recess diameters must not be committed until a coupon qualifies the hole delta on this exact process. The binding geometric risk is the 1.00 mm step between 2c and 10c: the clearance must be smaller than half that step or the denominations cross-enter.

failure_modes.mode: Clearance exceeds half the 1.00 mm 2c/10c step and a 2c coin drops into the 10c recess.
failure_modes.effect: Sorting fails; the product does not do its one job.
failure_modes.mitigation: Qualify the hole delta by coupon, then verify the 2c/10c pair explicitly on the tightest coupon.

failure_modes.mode: Recess is too tight and a coin cannot be lifted out.
failure_modes.mitigation: Finger notch on every recess plus a minus/nominal/plus coupon series.

acceptance_criteria: Each denomination enters its labelled recess without force and can be removed by the finger notch.
No coin enters a recess of a smaller denomination, verified explicitly on the 2c/10c pair.

interfaces.name: Tray to desk support plane

coordinate_frame.origin: centre of the flat printed underside

datums.description: flat printed underside, also the build-plate seat

constrained: tipping while coins are swept in

assembly.sequence_notes: Dry flat indoor surfaces only; the flat underside is the support-free print seat.

uncontrolled: loaded coin mass and its distribution

keepouts_and_access: No anti-slip claim from geometry alone.

loads_and_performance.host_load: loose coins only; no tension or impact

evidence.uncertainty_note: The flat seat is a CAD-owned design decision; no mass, centre of gravity or desk friction has been measured.

failure_modes.mode: The tray slides or tips while coins are swept in from a pocket.
failure_modes.effect: Coins scatter; the product is worse than no product.
failure_modes.mitigation: Keep the footprint wide and the walls low; verify a 10-degree tilt fully loaded.

acceptance_criteria: With every recess loaded the tray remains upright after a 10-degree tilt.
The tray does not slide during a one-handed pocket sweep.

interfaces.name: Adult finger to coin slope and finger notches

datums.description: slope surface and every recess finger notch

allowed: sweep coins across the slope with the flat of a hand
pick one coin via its notch
constrained: contact with a sharp or burred edge

assembly.sequence_notes: The slope is the defining usability feature: coins must not need fingernails.

dimensions.feature: minimum wall, three perimeters at the 0.4 mm nozzle

keepouts_and_access: Not a toy; coins are a choking hazard for children and the product carries no child-use scope.

evidence.uncertainty_note: Notch geometry is a usability decision with no measured basis; it needs a real-hand test.

failure_modes.mode: A coin sits flush in its recess and cannot be picked without a fingernail.
failure_modes.effect: Daily annoyance that defeats the pocket-emptying purpose.
failure_modes.mitigation: A finger notch on every recess, sized and then verified by a real-hand test.

acceptance_criteria: Every denomination can be picked out with a bare fingertip, without a fingernail.
No user-reachable edge is sharp to a bare-hand wipe.

drivers: INT 2/4: eight exact coin nominals whose smallest separation is only 1.00 mm.
GEO 2/4: a swept slope blended into a recessed floor is the defining usability geometry.
VER 2/4: separation must be proven per denomination pair, not once for the part.

blocking_unknowns: Calibration registry returns NO_MATCHING_PROCESS for Anycubic Kobra 3 Max / SUNLU PETG / 0.4 mm; hole_delta_vertical and xy_clearance_sliding are UNQUALIFIED. Recess diameters must not be committed until a coupon qualifies the hole delta on this exact process.
The 1.00 mm step between the 2c and 10c diameters is the tightest tolerance in the product and no process clearance is qualified.
Finger-notch geometry has no measured basis and needs a real-hand test.
No printed coupon, coin placement, separation, stability or 100-cycle result exists.

criticality.rationale: A dry indoor desk organiser for loose change. Credible failure is a coin in the wrong recess or a scattered sweep, not injury or loss of value. Loose coins are a child choking hazard, which is handled by excluding child use from scope rather than by a safety function.
credible_failure_effects: A 2c coin drops into the 10c recess and sorting silently fails.
A coin cannot be picked out without a fingernail.
The loaded tray slides during a pocket sweep and coins scatter.

decision.rationale: C2 with K1 and R3 gives Lane B, whose method is an interface master plus a fit coupon. All hard gates pass: coin diameters are fixed by EU regulation (E3), the manufacturing profile is the pinned hashed baseline, and per-denomination acceptance criteria exist. The controls are that recess diameters stay UNQUALIFIED parameters until the hole delta is qualified on this exact process, and that the 2c/10c pair with its 1.00 mm step is verified explicitly before any separation claim.

warnings.message: Calibration registry returns NO_MATCHING_PROCESS for Anycubic Kobra 3 Max / SUNLU PETG / 0.4 mm; hole_delta_vertical and xy_clearance_sliding are UNQUALIFIED. Recess diameters must not be committed until a coupon qualifies the hole delta on this exact process.
Eight denominations share one clearance parameter. The 1.00 mm 2c/10c step bounds it: the clearance must stay below half that step or denominations cross-enter.
Acceptance criteria and a coupon method exist; no test has been executed.

next_actions.action: Print the hole-gauge-vertical coupon on Anycubic Kobra 3 Max / SUNLU PETG Black / 0.4 mm / 0.20 mm, record a benchmark-measurement and update the calibration registry.
next_actions.exit_criterion: hole_delta_vertical is QUALIFIED and provably below 0.50 mm so the 2c/10c pair can separate.

next_actions.action: Print the tightest three-recess coupon covering 2c, 10c and 5c and verify placement, removal by fingertip and cross-entry.
next_actions.exit_criterion: All three acceptance criteria of IF-EXT-GEO-LOC-CYL-001 pass with recorded measurements.

next_actions.action: Run the real-hand notch test and the fully loaded 10-degree tilt test on a full tray.
